chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning Returns to a Bitter Truth: Mu Northson Has Vanished for 20 Years
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning returns to the Black-White College, only to learn his sworn brother Mu Northson has been missing for over twenty years with his Dao-companion dead. A quiet but devastating chapter of reunions and loss.
og_title: A Dark Homecoming: Ji Ning Learns of Northson's Vanishing
og_description: After decades away, Ji Ning returns to find his blood brother Mu Northson lost in shadow. A chapter of fragile hope and looming threat.
twitter_title: Ji Ning’s Bitter Return: Mu Northson Vanished 20+ Years Ago
twitter_description: The champion returns to a cold mystery—Northson is missing, and a storm is brewing. A quiet but crucial Desolate Era chapter.

lore_anchors.definition: A soul-linked artifact kept in a clan or sect's hall that shatters upon the owner's death, providing instant confirmation.
A cultivation partner bound by a shared Dao-heart and lifelong commitment; more than a romantic spouse, often a spiritual equal.
A cultivator who serves a stronger master in exchange for resources, protection, and access to training and teachings.
A title for a Wanxiang Adept, indicating their mastery of the Dao and respectable status in the cultivation world.
The oldest Loose Immortal of the Black-White College, known for his slovenly appearance and sharp judgment.
Ji Ning's personal peak within the Black-White College, named after his Dao-title.
The grand tournament held by the Grand Xia Dynasty to recruit the most talented Wanxiang Adepts.
